title: The 13 Best Food Processors
metaDescription: Our 13 picks for food processors, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at food processors using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cuisinart DFP-14BCWNYAMZ 14-Cup Food Processor
products.blurb: Key specs: 14-cup polycarbonate bowl with 1,200-watt motor, Die-cast metal base for stability under heavy loads, Extra-large feed tube fits a whole medium potato.
strengths: 1,200W motor and 14-cup bowl handle full-size batch cooking without bogging
Extra-large feed tube eliminates most pre-cutting for whole vegetables
Cuisinart's decades-long parts availability means it stays serviceable for 10 to 15 years
3-disc set covers chopping, slicing, and shredding out of the box
limitations: No variable speed, pulse and continuous only
One slicing thickness, no on-the-fly adjustment
No mini bowl for small-batch tasks like garlic or herbs
features: 14-cup polycarbonate bowl with 1,200-watt motor
